'''Triddle "Flip" Flipinigan''' was an individual who worked with [[Kaeline Ungasan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Kaeline Ungasan wished to become a new force in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] criminal activities. Fortunately for him, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] willing to help him during his stay in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Seeing [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as his greatest obstacle, Ungasan wished to forge an alliance with [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], a powerful enemy of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's empire]]. The spacer agreed, and was sent to deliver a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to Triddle "Flip" Flipinigan, containing a proposal for Ungasan to ally with Valarian.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateValarianEnforcer.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Triddle "Flip" Flipinigan]]

Triddle "Flip" Flipinigan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. Players who performed a series of quests for Ungasan in Mos Espa had to deliver a datadisc to Flipinigan outside the [[City/Legends|city]].

Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the gender, species, and appearance of Flipinigan changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the canonical gender and species of Flipinigan.
